Analysis by Richard Cowan
Updated October 13, 2005 6:00PM
(I will get back to a more orderly reporting with a completely new update tomorrow.)

Finally, after yet another 24 hours without any treatment for pain or even any antibiotics, Steve has  been released from the Seattle jail and has been taken to Haborview Hospital by Douglas Hiatt, who is a true hero. It is outrageous that it would take this long to resolve a "mix up in the paperwork", but Doug fought for Steve all the way.

We obviously do not know how long Steve will be in the hospital. I will report more about that tomorrow, Friday, October 14.

Originally Posted October 12, 2005
See
Steve Tuck Was Held In Whatcom County Jail WITHOUT MORPHINE! He Is In Agony! His Life Is In Danger.
and
 Steve Tuck Taken from Vancouver ER In Handcuffs to US Border. Will the Feds Kill Him?
and
The Banality of Evil  Canadian Style. Canada Rejects Steve Tucks Request for Pre-Removal Risk Assessment Adding Insult To Injury. We Will Appeal, Of Course.
and links

After being held for five days without any medication for his pain or even antibiotics for his infection, Steve Tuck was finally released from federal custody in the King County jail in Seattle this evening. (He was not moved to federal detention last night, nor was he given any pain medication, as they had promised his attorney.)
See
 Abuse In Prisons: Iraqi and American. Bush says, That is not the way we do things in America. No, That Is Exactly The Way We Do Things in America! Especially In Texas and Florida.

He is in great pain and is being taken to a hospital in Seattle, where he should have been taken last Friday. He has not only suffered indescribable agony and the ordeal of morphine withdrawal, he has been denied basic medical attention for the problems that resulted in his being fixed with a catheter in the Vancouver ER.

This inhumane ordeal was clearly illegal and violated Steves basic human rights. It was also completely pointless. It all could have been avoided if either Canada or the US had behaved in a humane manner.

Ironically, it is likely that the federal charges for interstate flight will be dropped. If I were a federal prosecutor I would not want to have to justify the behavior of either the state or federal authorities in this case.

When Steve fled Humboldt he did so because he feared that he would be denied morphine, not just medical cannabis, and that is precisely what happened. For years, we begged Canada to find out if it was safe for him to return, because he wanted to fight the charges in Humboldt.
See
 Live Free or Die  In Pain. The Ignorance and Arrogance of the Quacks Who Deny Pain Relief to the Sick and Dying.

Shamefully, Canadian officials ignored his pleas. Instead, they took him from an ER in Vancouver on the Friday before a long weekend when it was most likely that he would be denied medical care. He was not even allowed to make a phone call to me until 2AM!

Thanks to a large number of calls and emails from NORML members and others, Whatcom County got the feds to pick him up on Saturday, rather than wait until Tuesday. However, they then tried to hide Steve in the Seattle jail and he was not able to call me again until Monday. I then called Seattle attorney Douglas Hiatt, who has been a real hero.

Nonetheless, while the Seattle jail is much better than Whatcom Countys, Doug was still not able get him proper medical care. Bluntly, they lied to Doug.

We do not yet know when Steve will be physically able to return to Humboldt, but at that time we will need to be vigilant to see that he is safe. He needs a place to stay there, and it may be necessary to raise bail for him, perhaps $20,000. 

Please check back for daily updates on MarijuanaNews.

I was interviewed about Steve by Dean Becker on the 4:20 Drug War NEWS (MP3 audio)

www.endprohibition.org

A message from Steve Kubby:
See
Placer County, Still Murderous After All These Years. Kubbys Find Secret Death Warrant Signed by Disqualified Judge. Key To Canadian Refuge, If Not Justice In California.

"I was up all last night, reliving when Tuck and I were both jailed together in Vancouver. 

I was laying on the cold concrete cell, exhausted from a night of uncontrollable vomiting, bleeding out of both ends of my body, listening to the agonizing and torture of Steve Tuck in the cell next to me. 

Finally, a guard came by, not to help, but to order Steve to shut up. I explained Steve's terrible pain and need for medical treatment, to 
which the jail guard sneered, "Nobody gives a shit about a couple of pathetic American pot heads and their bullshit medical problems."
See
Kubby and Tuck Freed After Being Held Hellish Conditions. Marc Emery Posts Bail. MarijuanaNews Bulletin

Steve Kubby now is in fear of being taken by the same cowardly thugs from "Canadian Border Services" who took Steve Tuck to the US. They have seized the Kubbys' passports and now claim that they cannot find Steve Kubby's medical records which show that he will die if he is deprived of cannabis.

Tuck has endured enormous pain and his life is still in danger because the US will not even give him basic medical care. They will certainly not give Steve Kubby cannabis. They will watch him die, and Canada will be complicit in murder.
